name: Laminar
description: Trace, evaluate, and debug AI agents with open-source observability — captures LLM calls, tool calls, and sub-agent spans, then clusters recurring failure modes into eval datasets.

skills.name: Agent Tracing
skills.description: Records nested spans for LLM calls, tool invocations, and sub-agent runs so a full trajectory is reconstructable.

skills.name: Failure Clustering
skills.description: Groups similar failed runs into recurring failure modes instead of leaving them as unrelated one-off errors.

skills.name: Eval Datasets
skills.description: Promotes traced production runs into labelled datasets used to score changes before they ship.
